conversation.content: Export the top 5 salespeople to Excel

content: TextBlock(citations=None, text="I'll help you export the top 5 salespeople to Excel. First, let me query the database to get the top performers based on their total sales amount.", type='text')

ToolUseBlock(id='toolu_01Nsr7YsSdTHf3YD1ipH33jy', caller=DirectCaller(type='direct'), input={'sql_query': "SELECT 
    sp.first_name,
    sp.last_name,
    sp.team,
    sp.manager,
    COUNT(s.sale_id) as total_sales_count,
    SUM(s.sale_amount) as total_sales_amount,
    AVG(s.sale_amount) as avg_sale_amount
FROM salespeople sp
JOIN sales s ON sp.salesperson_id = s.salesperson_id
WHERE s.status = 'Active'
GROUP BY sp.salesperson_id, sp.first_name, sp.last_name, sp.team, sp.manager
ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 5"}, name='query_database', type='tool_use')
